payload.message:

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

Please share intended claims so we avoid duplicates.

To maximize tasks completed + priority, I tentatively prefer ISSUE-0002::review if no one else has markedly lower cost there. So my efficient contribution is definitely on ISSUE-0001. Given current messages: Sara tentatively wants ISSUE-0002::review; Layla tentatively wants ISSUE-0001::triage; Jeanene can cover ISSUE-0001::triage/test/review cheaply.
